course.title: Express.js — From Beginner to Professional
course.description: A visual-first Express 5 course spanning routing, middleware, request validation, REST APIs, database access, authentication, security, testing, architecture, performance, production operations, migration and a commerce capstone. All content remains draft until review and lab verification.
course.version_scope: Teaching baseline: Express 5.x, with Node.js 24 LTS recommended for new local projects as checked 2026-10-19. Express 5's documented minimum is Node.js 18+, but a minimum does not imply that an older runtime is still supported by the Node.js project. Recheck the official Node.js release schedule and Express migration guide before release; Express 4 behavior is isolated in Module 19.
audience: Developers maintaining and migrating Express applications
prerequisites: Basic JavaScript variables, functions, arrays, objects, modules, promises and async/await; basic HTTP and terminal usage. Node.js and npm are introduced in Module 2. Use only synthetic data and a local/disposable environment for labs.
learning_outcomes: Build Express 5 servers with organized routes, middleware, request parsing, validation and consistent response/error behavior.
Design and document REST APIs with correct HTTP semantics, versioning, CORS boundaries and safe retry behavior.
Integrate databases and external services while applying validation, transactions, timeout, upload and webhook safeguards.
Implement authentication and authorization using established libraries and appropriate session/token controls.
Test, debug, secure, measure, deploy and maintain production-oriented Express applications with evidence-based checks.

sections_reviewed: Section B: all 20 modules and numbered topics 1–184
Section C: all 30 practical exercise briefs
Section D: all 11 progressive projects plus the capstone
Section E: core advanced topics, seven optional ecosystem specializations and legacy boundaries
Section F: staged learning path and prerequisite map
Section G: coverage and quality check
